title: Beethoven's bone conduction

tellings.quote: he was deaf and he used something called bone conduction

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the composer Beethoven, after going deaf in Vienna in the early 1800s, used something called bone conduction, which means hearing sound through vibrations carried by the bones of the head. Michels brings it up while talking about unusual ways people take in signals and information.
